case.title: LEGO build
case.request: Make a useful connected LEGO build with the photographed bricks and plate, without inventing pieces.

messages: Make a useful connected LEGO build with the photographed bricks and plate, without inventing pieces.

reviewQuestions: Are materials grounded and quantities sufficient?
Are steps complete and captions faithful?
Does the final result follow from shown operations?

design.purpose: A connected two-pier bridge and display deck for a small toy car or figure, made only from the four photographed 2×2 bricks and the brown 2×8 plate. A small toy can stand on the deck or pass through the clear space between the piers.

steps.c: Place the green brick on the floor grid.
Stack the dark red brick fully on the green brick.
Place the red brick six studs along the grid.
Stack the orange brick fully on the red brick.
Lay the brown plate across both pier tops.
